name: Sirdata
comment: Sirdata CMP. Replaces autoconsent's rule: its accept button selector is a generated class name that changes between versions; the button is found by its "accept all" label instead.

optIn.waitForThenClick: xpath///*[@id='sd-cmp']//*[self::button or @role='button'][normalize-space(.)='Tout accepter' or normalize-space(.)='Accept all' or normalize-space(.)='Alle akzeptieren' or normalize-space(.)='Aceptar todo' or normalize-space(.)='Accetta tutto' or normalize-space(.)='Aceitar tudo' or normalize-space(.)='Alles accepteren' or normalize-space(.)='Akceptuj wszystko' or normalize-space(.)='Acceptera alla' or normalize-space(.)='Accepter alle' or normalize-space(.)='Přijmout vše' or normalize-space(.)='Acceptați tot' or normalize-space(.)='Összes elfogadása' or normalize-space(.)='Αποδοχή όλων' or normalize-space(.)='Приемане на всички']
